name: GripMock gRPC Mock Server
free_limit: MIT-licensed local/self-hosted gRPC mock server supporting .proto/.pb descriptors, unary and streaming RPCs, YAML/JSON stubs, runtime stub edits, request matching, errors/delays, and a web dashboard; no vendor-imposed software quota or expiration.
watch_out: Runs on your own machine, Docker host or CI runner; no free hosted endpoints, compute, network or storage included. Secure the management API/dashboard if exposed; optional upstream proxy/capture may contact external systems. Plugin builds depend on compatible Go platform and image variants.
